newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra says may cooperate with Fincantieri.
newsitem.headline: Metra says may cooperate with Fincantieri.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Metra Oy Ab said in a statement on Friday it had started negotiations with Italian Fincantieri's 50 percent owned New Sulzer Diesel Group.
"Metra and Fincantieri Cantieri Navali Italiani S.p.A. are negotiating a possible cooperation between the Wartsila Diesel Group and the New Sulzer Diesel Group," Metra said.
"There is no certainty of the final result of the negotiations at this stage," Metra said.

Fincantieri holds 50 percent of New Sulzer Diesel and has an agreement to buy the rest from Vulcan Industrie Holding GmbH which is controlled by the bankruptcy estate of Bremer Vulcan Verbund AG, Metra said.
It did not give any details on the planned cooperation.
